subject: Re: Follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Wu <jane.wu@acme.com>, Brian Thompson <brian.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs

Hi Jane / Brian —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our call and next steps specific to the PII / data handling items you raised: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- Use case: Acme will send customer support prompts that may include names, order IDs, and occasionally contact info.
- Primary asks: (1) what of prompts/outputs are stored, (2) data retention windows, (3) logging/obfuscation controls, and (4) ability to keep data in US-only regions.

Short answers up-front (detailed below and attaching SOC2 summary + PII data-flow diagram):
- Prompts: transient for inference; short-term logs are kept to support debugging and quality; configurable retention.
- Outputs: by default treated as customer data; retained for 30 days for observability/error analysis unless otherwise limited by contract.
- Embeddings/derived vectors: persisted only when customer chooses to store them (we don’t automatically index prompts into embeddings).
- Residency: hosted offering supports US-only residency; Dedicated/Private gives full control.

Requested next steps from our side:
1) I’ll send the SOC2 summary and a one-page PII handling diagram (attached).
2) Neha (cc’d) will follow up with a short note summarizing retention defaults and options for making logs ephemeral or disabling logging for sensitive routes.
3) If helpful, we can do a tech deep-dive with your security/infra team — propose Thu 8/27 10am PT.

Please reply if any of the short answers above are incorrect or if you want us to exclude outputs entirely from retention for your account.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, pii-data-flow.png
From: Jane Wu <jane.wu@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brian Thompson <brian.thompson@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs

Thanks Rishi — good recap. A few clarifying questions so we can scope with procurement/security: 

1) When you say "short-term logs are kept to support debugging": how long is that by default (days)? Are request/response bodies included in those logs or only metadata?
2) For outputs retained 30 days by default: can we opt into "no retention" for our account (i.e., purge immediately after response) or restrict retention to an internal customer-managed S3?
3) Embeddings: we will be storing embeddings in our own vector DB, but want to confirm Redwood does not create or persist embeddings from prompts without explicit API calls.
4) Data residency: we require US-only processing and storage for this pilot. Can you confirm both inference and logs will remain in US regions for a hosted account?

Procurement timeline: we are aiming to sign pilot SOW by 9/10; if security items are OK we can fast-track. Also, can you share a completed security questionnaire (we’ve attached ours in the call).

Thanks —
Jane Wu
Head of Product Security, Acme Corp
jane.wu@acme.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Wu <jane.wu@acme.com>, Brian Thompson <brian.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs

Jane — thanks for the clear list. Answers inline below and next steps.

1) Debugging/log retention length (default): 30 days. Those logs include request/response bodies for a short period to aid debugging and outlier detection; access is tightly controlled and only retained to support incident investigations and model quality. Logs can be configured to 7/14/30 days or disabled for specific routes.

2) Opt-out / immediate purge: Yes. For hosted accounts we can set a retention policy to purge outputs immediately (TTL=0) for specific endpoints. For customers who want stronger guarantees, Redwood Dedicated or Private allows you to manage retention yourself. If you prefer, we can configure your pilot account to not persist outputs beyond the inference window; that is a standard option.

3) Embeddings: Correct — we do not auto-generate or persist embeddings from prompts unless the customer explicitly calls the embeddings API or enables a feature that creates them. You will need to call embeddings endpoints to have vectors created/stored.

4) Data residency: Hosted US regions: inference and logs can be constrained to US-only regions for your account. We will document the region controls in the SOW. Dedicated/Private provides stronger guarantees (customer-managed VPC).

Attachments: security-questionnaire.xlsx (filled with short answers), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. Also attaching a simple PII data-flow image.

Proposed next steps:
- Security deep-dive: Thu 8/27 10:00 AM PT (we’re available) — invite sent separately.
- Neha will follow up with a one-page summary of retention defaults and an example config to set TTL=0 on sensitive endpoints.
- If acceptable, we’ll include retention and residency clauses in the pilot SOW.

Let me know if you’d like any of this updated into the SOW language before procurement review.

Best,
Rishi
